prompts.label: Soft blocks
prompts.style: Visual language: soft block-cut forms, broad white surfaces, friendly rounded foliage and rounded corners, chunky clean one-native-pixel black contours, restrained gray under eaves and along one side. Modern towers have soft stepped parapets and broad clean glass panels.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: supplemental sprite source sheet for a classic top-down 1-bit handheld RPG. This extends a simple readable pixel world kit with MODERN HIGH-RISE CITY, COASTAL WATER and DESERT pieces.
Create exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows of 16 isolated sprites, each in its own cell with generous genuinely transparent gutters. Production sprite sheet, not scenes, no labels. Crisp square pixel blocks with only opaque black, white and one gray #999999; white interiors remain opaque. Gray is limited to small purposeful shadow masses, no baked dithering or gradients, no antialiasing. No checkerboard or background image.
Exact row-major subjects:
ROW 1:
1. MODERN GLASS OFFICE TOWER, native 48x96 pixels, three 16px columns and six 16px storeys: flat rooftop first row, four modular glass-window floor rows, visible ground-level recessed entrance bottom row. Perfect vertical edges, same facade width across floors so floor rows can repeat. Flat top-down-RPG front elevation with a little visible roof; NOT isometric. A few large dark glazing panels, no tiny detailed windows.
2. MODERN CONCRETE APARTMENT TOWER, native 48x80, three tile columns by five tile rows: flat roof, three simple modular window storeys, lobby entrance. Straight sides and repeatable floor bands.
3. LOW MODERN GLASS STOREFRONT, native 48x32, flat roof/canopy, broad shop windows and centered glass door, no words.
4. ASPHALT ROAD SQUARE, native 16x16, opaque black borderless repeating tile with a short vertical white lane dash; calm empty road surface.
ROW 2:
5. OPEN SEA SQUARE, opaque borderless 16x16 black water tile with just two short white wave marks.
6. PALE BEACH SAND SQUARE, opaque borderless 16x16 white tile with two sparse black shell/pebble marks; no frame.
7. WOODEN PIER SEGMENT, transparent 32x16, rectangular horizontal plank deck and chunky corner posts, repeatable end to end.
8. SMALL MOTORBOAT, transparent 32x16, side/top view pointing right, simple white hull with black interior, no surrounding water.
ROW 3:
9. PALM TREE, transparent 32x48, large readable splayed fronds, slim bent trunk, full tree.
10. REED CLUMP, transparent 16x16, three dark stepped leaf silhouettes.
11. SAGUARO CACTUS, transparent 16x32, readable two-arm silhouette with one or two white internal cuts.
12. SANDSTONE BOULDER, transparent 32x32, big angular white top and small gray layered side faces.
ROW 4:
13. DESERT SAND GROUND, opaque borderless 16x16 white tile, just two little stepped dune ripples and minimal gray, no all-over texture.
14. LOW SANDSTONE MESA, transparent 32x32, flat top, stepped cliff edge, two simple sediment bands.
15. ADOBE DESERT HOUSE, transparent 48x32, low flat roof, dark recessed door, small window, simple block construction, no ground backdrop.
16. DRY DESERT SHRUB, transparent 16x16, branching dark silhouette and sparse white cuts.
Keep assets entirely inside their cells, no cast shadows into other cells. The larger items will be sliced into 16x16 pieces; the tower's intermediate floor rows must be reusable to create buildings of different heights. The playable camera is 128x64 with a 16px player, so bold silhouettes and calm surfaces are essential. No player, no humans, no text, no logos, no watermark.
Visual language: soft block-cut forms, broad white surfaces, friendly rounded foliage and rounded corners, chunky clean one-native-pixel black contours, restrained gray under eaves and along one side. Modern towers have soft stepped parapets and broad clean glass panels.

prompts.label: Ink silhouettes
prompts.style: Visual language: bold ink silhouettes, darker glass towers and palm crowns with generous white negative-space cuts, angular modern concrete, crisp stepped contours, sparse gray accents. Keep walkable ground light and water/road dark.
